detail.longDescription: Here is a fun project if you want to make an open-source Meta Muse Charm. It is a cheap ESP32-S3 talking toy from Shanghai talking to my Mac/Linux desktop app (BoBe), with zero API keys on the chip. I mapped the screen, audio and power-latch pins with no schematic, and wired a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 to press its physical buttons automatically behind a packet-loss router to test bad Wi-Fi. Not selling anything, just a hobby project, all is free and open source on GitHub, if you find it interesting feel free to use it: https://johnkozaris.com/blog/bobe-toy-robot-body
